The user's most recent message was: "process .dic and other files in \ordbøger\ddo-dsl 1) process .dic and other files in \ordbøger\ddo-dsl 2) in ordlister/wordlist_ne_scored.tsv: we need to drastically reduce the number of assumed posts with marker beginning from namedEntity until category noun_or_ne, e.g. position 1 to 28116 in the index."
